verificationNote: Verified against the official Supreme Court of India judgment PDF. The official record identifies the case as Addanki Narayanappa & Anr. v. Bhaskara Krishtappa and Ors., judgment dated 21 January 1966, AIR 1966 SC 1300, (1966) 3 SCR 400. The judgment holds, inter alia, that the dissolution/settlement document did not itself convey immovable property so as to require registration under Section 17(1)(c) of the Registration Act.
